rules.description: Verify MaxDate is within allowable publication lag (3 years for annual series, 5 years for quinquennial census) and values are non-negative (and within [0, 100] for rates) for active recurring indicators

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, MinValue, MaxValue, NumPlaces, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats WHERE NOT regexp_matches(StatVar, '^Count_Person_1(00To104|05To109|10OrMore)Years')
params.condition: CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - CASE WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, '^(Count_(Student|Teacher|Death|MortalityEvent|Person_(Employed|Unemployed|NotInLaborForce))|UnemploymentRate_Person)') THEN 3 ELSE 5 END) AND total_svs >= 92 AND NumPlaces >= 1 AND MinValue >= 0 AND (StatVar != 'UnemploymentRate_Person' OR MaxValue <= 100)

rules.description: Verify MaxDate is at least the last published census wave (2020) and values are non-negative for discontinued historical centenarian sub-brackets

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, MinValue, MaxValue, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats WHERE regexp_matches(StatVar, '^Count_Person_1(00To104|05To109|10OrMore)Years')
params.condition: CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2020 AND total_svs >= 9 AND MinValue >= 0

rules.description: Ensure all 75 active Population Census indicators share a consistent MaxDate
Ensure annual Labor Force Survey and Vital Statistics total death indicators share a consistent MaxDate
Ensure School Basic Survey teacher indicators share a consistent MaxDate
Ensure School Basic Survey student enrollment indicators share a consistent MaxDate
Ensure Vital Statistics cause-of-death indicators share a consistent MaxDate
Ensure historical centenarian sub-brackets share a consistent MaxDate
